C9000164.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 164 (Hindman’s finite sums and products conjecture.; papers: Monochromatic finite sums and products in the positive integers; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

MS_MAIN.statement: For every finite coloring and m,R,D there are separated a_1<...<a_m whose nonempty subset sums and products all have one color; separation is a_1>R and a_d>R(sum_{k<d}a_k+prod_{k<d}a_k)^D.
MS_MAIN.scope: Manuscript assertion, not certified by the rough-step mission.

MS_PREDICTION.statement: Prediction principle pr:prediction: calibrated bounded-step piecewise nilsequence models approximate the weighted simultaneous sum/product count.

MS_ALIGNMENT.statement: Alignment principle pr:alignment: a positive uniform alignment mass for admissible models, obtained using finite word recurrence, cube symmetries, and removal of tail-product sampling factors.

MS_CHAIN.statement: lem:chain-selection: a sufficiently long product list has an m-block chain whose nonempty block-products have one color.

MS_SCALES.statement: lem:master-scales and prop:linear-forms provide admissible arithmetic scales, prime-pool/divisibility control, and weighted linear-forms estimates.

MS_CORRELATION.statement: prop:correlation-test: uniform weighted correlation control after prime insertion, mask removal, polynomial-direction reduction, and additive elimination.

MS_MODELS.statement: lem:dual-pseudorandomness and prop:dense-model give bounded dense models tested by lem:nilsequence-testing.

MS_CUBE.statement: prop:local-cube-law and prop:face-lift give local cube laws and lift marginal face symmetries to joint configurations.

MS_WORDPLAN.statement: lem:finite-word-plan converts nilpotent polynomial recurrence into finitely many scale updates and jumps.

MS_ROUGH_RESIDUAL.statement: cor:rough-residual-step removes one factor t from a fixed retained class modulo q, without requiring gcd(q,t)=1.

RS_VERIFY.statement: Proposition prop:rough-step with its full sequential uniformity over jointly log-polynomial coefficients and per-step adaptive boxes, residues, and bounded Lipschitz tests.
RS_VERIFY.review_status: Engineer proof supplied; independent Reviewer and independent citation attribution pending.

RS_POWER.statement: For n=dim G>=1, step cap s>=1 and degree D>=1, the full adaptive coefficient-uniform rough-step postcondition holds already under Z>=kappa*S^(2*D*s^(n-1)+2) for any fixed kappa>0, with every other hypothesis unchanged.
RS_POWER.review_status: Candidate strengthening; neither novelty nor independent acceptance is asserted.

RS_DENSITY.statement: A positive-density exceptional set contains every fixed length of progression with smooth difference; finite color refinements preserve arbitrarily long bad progression families.

RS_DESCENT.statement: A bad progression family descends to one of finitely many fixed rational kernel nilmanifolds of smaller dimension, with all new analytic constants independent of progression length.

RS_HAAR_BOX.statement: Haar discrepancy on a comparable box yields a common bounded horizontal character and monomial coefficient obstructions, uniformly in polynomial coefficients.

RS_FILTERED.statement: A logarithmic polynomial of ordinary total degree D is polynomial for the fixed stretched lower-central filtration of degree sD.

RS_INTERPOLATION.statement: Exact division interpolation has an H-independent error constant; only its smooth denominators and asymptotic exactness threshold depend on the fixed progression length H.

RS_EXACT_ALGEBRA.statement: Rational gap forcing, polynomial linear-factor exact division, coprime-denominator cancellation, and orientation-correct group kernel factorization.
RS_EXACT_ALGEBRA.mechanical_scope: Universal exact algebra only; the compiler does not prove the analytic theorem or verify statement fidelity.

RS_KERNEL.statement: Horizontal splitting gives a kernel log-polynomial of degree at most sD; the quotient lattices depend only on a fixed finite character list and finitely many residues, not on interpolation denominators.

RS_COUNTS.statement: Freezing on boundedly many subboxes and splitting modulo fixed K preserves a fixed discrepancy; the CRT reparametrization retains the original step t.

RS_GT_EQUAL.statement: External input: corrected quantitative Leibman theorem on equal-side boxes, with a fixed rational adapted basis and coefficient-independent constants.

RS_SZEMEREDI.statement: External input: finite Szemeredi theorem; finite van der Waerden follows by taking density 1/number_of_colors.

RS_RATIONAL_GEOMETRY.statement: External rational nilpotent Lie-group structure: rational connected subgroups meet lattices in lattices, rational conjugation preserves the rational structure, and BCH is a finite rational Lie polynomial.
